verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Deel has a time-off concept: an MCP tool, `createTimeOffRequest`, submits time-off requests, and Deel's MCP server exposes time data alongside payroll. Deel also runs payroll across 150+ countries. None of it shows an ops user defining PTO policies, configuring accrual rules, setting approval workflows, or having approved leave flow into payroll automatically. Missing for 10: PTO policy definition, accrual configuration, approval workflows, automatic payroll application of PTO, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
